title: Matter — Add Member Request
description: Request body for POST /api/pact/matters/{id}/members. Owner-only. At the Authorization-Required tier, cross-org member adds MUST carry §17.6 authorization_proof (§24.3).

principal_id.description: DID of the principal to add.

display_name.description: Display name within the Matter. Defaults to the principal_id if omitted.

authorization_proof.description: REQUIRED at the Authorization-Required tier when the added principal is cross-org. §17.6 envelope.
